author: SALTO Participation & Information
title: Call for illustrator: democracy stickers
content: 🎨 Calling all artists and illustrators: Help bring participation and democracy to life! SALTO Participation & Information is looking for an illustrator, artist, or illustration-led organisation to create a collection of approximately 10–15 original illustrations inspired by participation, democracy, active citizenship, inclusion, critical thinking, community, cooperation, access to information, and having a voice. The illustrations will primarily become a series of fun and engaging stickers shared across the SALTO PI community. We are open to different styles and want to give the selected illustrator plenty of creative freedom to bring their own ideas and artistic identity to the collection. Open to illustrators worldwide. Fee: €1,500 for the full assignment. Approximately 10–15 original illustrations. Application deadline: 8 November 2026. Final illustrations completed by 18 December 2026. Generative AI illustrations will not be accepted. Applications should include a short professional profile, selected portfolio, brief creative direction, and one example or early concept. Find the full call and application details on our website or link in bio. Contact via website/link in bio.
